title: reference oracle formfill comparator shape mismatch
discovered_by: EA04 dual-path formfill witnesses (new family-level witness coverage; the prior 40 obligation-B witnesses covered C03 formatting only)
symptom: every CORRECT formfill answer scored INCORRECT by the reference path (production CORRECT vs reference INCORRECT -> NOT_EVALUABLE) on all 20 dev formfill cases
root_cause: oracle._compare_typed compared the interpreter's raw single-field dict {field: value} against the derived {'field': F, 'value': V} record shape
fix: exact (field, value) pair comparison in oracle._compare_typed AND strict pair comparison in production _eval_c03 (both sides exact; no silent normalization)

verification.empty_truth_formatting_cases: 2/160 EMPTY_OUTPUT (agreed by both paths; disclosed limitiation: a formatting case whose truth is an empty line list cannot be scored CORRECT under the pinned output contract)
verification.gt_battery_rerun: 160/160 VALID, 38/38 probes, 597/597 mutations detected, 40/40 obligation-B witnesses (no regression)
